plain: In 1999 a French committee, known as COMETA, put out a report on unexplained flying objects. A scientist named Kevin Knuth, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says the report concluded that these things could be alien spacecraft, that there might be a base somewhere in our solar system, and that the United States is probably hiding information. If true, it would mean a serious group in another country reached that conclusion on paper.
